STORY-FEAT4-013.title: Construct External Links for Provider Profile
STORY-FEAT4-013.description: Enhance provider detail service to generate external links including state medical board pages and research site URLs based on provider attributes.

STORY-FEAT4-014.title: Validate and Sanitize Provider External URLs
STORY-FEAT4-014.description: Integrate URL validation to ensure all generated provider links are reachable, safe, and properly formatted before returning in response.

STORY-FEAT4-015.title: Handle NPI API Errors and Fallback Behavior
STORY-FEAT4-015.description: Implement robust error handling for NPI Registry failures including timeouts, empty results, and malformed responses, returning graceful degraded provider detail output.
